# ============================================================================
# CANDIDATES, NOT SOURCES. Nothing in this file is crawled.
#
# These 744 SAP SuccessFactors RMK triples were recovered by a research pass in
# a container with no outbound access to job boards, so not one of them was
# probed by this project. docs/adding-a-source.md is explicit that a slug nobody
# has verified must not be registered, and at this project's fan-out a dead
# tenant is not free: it burns a request every crawl, reports as a failing
# source, and enough of them together trip the Source Health workflow's
# 35%-failure alarm, which is the signal that is supposed to mean a real
# platform broke.
#
# The 30 highest-volume triples from this file's hand-curated head are
# registered in internal/services/successfactors.go as
# SuccessFactorsTenants. The rest are staged here until a CI job — the only
# place in this project with real network access — can probe them.
#
# Promotion rule, gated on content and not on status code: keep a triple whose
# feed answers 200 with an XML declaration, a <Job-Listing> root and a <Job>
# count above zero. A wrong host or company id answers 200 with a short HTML
# page, so a status-code check would promote garbage.
#
# The verification claims and posting counts below are the upstream curator's,
# dated as annotated. They are recorded as provenance, not endorsed.
# ============================================================================
#
# SAP SuccessFactors "Recruiting Marketing" (RMK) career-site tenants to poll,
# one `slug,companyId,host` triple per line (# = comment, inline OK).
#
#   slug       human-facing employer key -> source_slug (keep it clean/lowercase)
#   companyId  the ?company= value in the RMK career URL (case-sensitive, e.g.
#              nestleHRprdBX) -- NOT guessable
#   host       career{N}.successfactors.{com|eu} -- the host number AND the tld are
#              tenant-specific and not guessable (career5.successfactors.com is
#              NXDOMAIN while career5.successfactors.eu is live)
#
# Polled by download/fetch_successfactors.py via the public keyless XML feed
#   /career?company={companyId}&career_ns=job_listing_summary&resultType=XML
# (one request returns the whole open-req corpus, full descriptions inline -- no
# per-posting detail fetch). The enterprise segment the Workday/Oracle/iCIMS lanes
# miss: SuccessFactors is the SAP-shop Fortune-500 / European-giant cluster.
#
# Each triple VERIFIED live (feed returned <Job-Listing> with total>0, 2026-06-14).
# When adding: probe BOTH .com and .eu and walk career{1..8} -- a wrong host returns
# a tiny text/html page (0 jobs), the right one an octet-stream XML feed.

# --- 2026-06-15 wholesale expansion: +690 strict+richness-verified tenants (51->741) ---
#   Source: cetteup SF-instance registry (sf-instance-api.cetteup.com, ~1140 RMK
#   instances w/ domain+company_id+rcm_domain, last_seen daily) bulk-probed against the
#   strict gate (HTTP200 + octet-stream + <?xml + <Job-Listing> + <Job> count>0) AND a
#   description-richness gate (>=60% of jobs with >40ch of description text -- drops
#   title-only feeds like LOGIN). Slugs derived from the registry's candidate domain.
#   Two non-successfactors host patterns included (connector is host-agnostic, builds
#   https://{host}/career?... verbatim): career{N}.sapsf.com and career-hcm20.ns2cloud.com
#   (SAP NS2 GovCloud: L3Harris/Entergy/ORNL/...). Location is tenant-dependent (some
#   feeds expose no location facet); description+apply-URL always present.
